Wider windows

The same three roots, composed for the space instead of stretched into it. Five width classes are implemented; these two are the ones with real second panes.

The palette

No neutral is grey. Every one carries a low-chroma warm bias, so light reads as unbleached paper and dark as warm charcoal. The six accents are three complementary pairs, and the status colours are drawn from the same family — which is why a warning never clashes with whichever accent is active.

Captured on an API 36 emulator from a seeded day, then verified there: 340 unit tests, 101 instrumentation tests, both lints, and a minified release that installs, launches, and navigates. What these plates cannot show is your own calendar, a screen reader, or a tablet you actually hold — those remain separate evidence, and the plan says so.
